bias.en: Bullish trend · at a record, overbought
bias.zh: 多头趋势 · 创纪录，超买

read.en: Palantir closed at a record $209.05 on Oct 9, up 5% on the day and above the old $207.18 closing high from Nov 3, 2025. The averages are stacked in bullish order (5-day $197 > 10-day $192 > 30-day $183 > 100-day $154), and MACD is above its signal with the histogram widening for three days. The stretch is the warning: RSI is 76, and the stock is 14% above its 30-day average.
read.zh: Palantir 于 10月9日以 $209.05 创收盘纪录，当日上涨 5%，超越 2025年11月3日 $207.18 的旧收盘高点。均线呈多头排列（5 日 $197 > 10 日 $192 > 30 日 $183 > 100 日 $154），MACD 位于信号线上方，柱体连续三日放大。警示在于涨幅过大：RSI 为 76，股价高出 30 日均线 14%。

read.en: There is no overhead supply, so resistance is the Oct 9 intraday record of $209.58 and then round numbers at $220 and $230. First support is the 5-day average and Oct 8 close near $197–199. Below that, $192–194 (10-day average, Sep 24 high and the Oct 6–7 closes) and the 30-day average near $183 are where the rally would be properly tested. The stock moves about $6 a day on average, so expect wide swings around the Nov 2 report.
read.zh: 上方无套牢盘，阻力为 10月9日盘中纪录 $209.58，其后为 $220 与 $230 整数关口。首个支撑为 5 日均线与 10月8日收盘（约 $197–199）。再往下，$192–194（10 日均线、9月24日高点及 10月6–7日收盘）与约 $183 的 30 日均线才是真正检验涨势的位置。日均波幅约 $6，11月2日财报前后波动可能较大。

r.zh: 整数关口；高盛新目标价
